_comment: Model manifest. Every URL and sizeBytes here was verified against the Hugging Face Hub,
Digests: the VAD and ASR entries carry SHA-256 values computed by downloading those exact
URLs and hashing the bytes. The GGUF chat models do not, because their digests are not
retrievable without downloading several gigabytes each. Their sizeBytes are exact, which
is what catches the realistic failure (a truncated or interrupted download); a substituted
file would not be caught, and hashVerified:false says so. The installer treats a null
digest as size-checked only and the UI tells the user.
Three tiers, and nothing that cannot run on 12 GB:
LOW    6-8 GB   all-day: Gemma 3 1B (0.81 GB). No heavy model: nothing bigger fits.
MEDIUM 12 GB    all-day: Qwen 3 1.7B (1.11 GB). Sized for all-day use beside ASR.
HIGH   12 GB    charging and idle only: Qwen 3 4B (2.50 GB).
Dropped: Phi-4-mini (2.49 GB, the same size as Qwen 3 4B but weaker for the heavy role,
and far too heavy to hold all day) and Qwen 3 8B (5.03 GB of weights, which does not load
reliably beside the recorder on 12 GB — it is not offered rather than offered and killed).

models.notes: Gates ASR so speech recognition only runs on actual speech. Tiny, and the single biggest battery saving in the pipeline. Without it the app falls back to an energy threshold.
English transcription. Archive contains encoder.int8.onnx, decoder.int8.onnx, joiner.int8.onnx and tokens.txt; the installer flattens them into models/asr/ and discards the bundled test audio.

LOW tier (6-8 GB phones): the all-day chat and correction model. 0.81 GB of weights is the most that can sit beside the recorder on an 8 GB phone without the system killing one of them. Under Google's Gemma terms, not a standard open licence.

MEDIUM tier (12 GB phones, the default here): the all-day chat and correction model. Chosen for sustained use rather than peak quality — 1.11 GB memory-maps in about a second, so the correction pass every few minutes costs a short CPU burst instead of paging gigabytes in and out all day.

HIGH tier (12 GB phones, charging and idle only): the biggest model that loads reliably on 12 GB beside the ASR pipeline. 2.5 GB of weights plus KV cache is about the limit of what a 12 GB phone has free in practice, which is why it is never loaded on battery.
